questions.question_type: Multiple Statements — Correct Combination by Code
questions.explanation: The Meghalaya Plateau is an outlier extension of the Peninsular Plateau and became separated from the main peninsula due to faulting. The Kashmir Valley was formed in a synclinal structure of the Himalayas; therefore, statement II is correct. The Ganga Plain developed in a foredeep formed in front of the rising Himalayas and was gradually filled by alluvial deposits brought by rivers. Hence, statement III is correct. The Himalayas originated due to the collision of the Indian Plate with the Eurasian Plate, not due to any triangular convergence. Therefore, statement (IV) is incorrect. Hence, the correct answer is option (a).

questions.q: The Indian monsoon is indicated by seasonal displacement because of –

questions.explanation: The Indian monsoon is characterized by a seasonal shift (reversal of seasonal wind direction). Its direction remains from north-east to south-west for about six months (in winter), and for the remaining six months (in summer) it remains from south-west to north-east. The origin of these monsoon winds is linked to temperature differences, though there has been considerable debate on this. Two main concepts have been proposed for this— Thermal concept: The monsoon originates due to the differential heating/cooling of land and water and their opposite nature of warming and cooling; that is, the northward and southward movement of the Sun has a significant effect. Modern concept: According to the modern view, monsoon winds originate due to changes in air pressure and the shifting of pressure belts and wind belts. This concept was first presented by a scholar named Flohn.

During the monsoon retreat season, the sky becomes clear and temperature starts rising, while nights become cool and pleasant. In the latter half of October, temperature starts falling rapidly; this fall is seen especially in northern India.

questions.q: The high tide in the Ocean is caused by

Ocean tides are mainly the result of the Moon’s gravitational pull. The Moon is much closer to the Earth than the Sun. Due to its attraction, sea water rises and forms tides. The gravitational pull of the Sun is not as effective. Therefore, the tides caused by the Sun do not rise as much as those caused by the Moon. It is notable that the tide-generating power of the Moon is about 2.17 times that of the Sun.

It is formed when nitrogen oxides (NOx) and volatile organic compounds (VOCs) released from vehicles, industries, and power plants react in the presence of sunlight.

questions.explanation: For research on temperate forests in India, the (HFRI) Himalayan Forest Research Institute has been established at Shimla (Himachal Pradesh) under the Indian Council of Forestry Research and Education (ICFRE).

questions.q: The National Environmental Engineering Research Institute is located at—
questions.question_type: Standard MCQ — Direct Factual/Conceptual, Single Correct
questions.explanation: The National Environmental Engineering Research Institute (NEERI) is located in Nagpur, Maharashtra.

questions.q: Earth Day, observed on 22 April, is related to—
questions.question_type: Standard MCQ — Direct Factual/Conceptual, Single Correct

options.A: The end day of the Second World War
options.B: Ban on nuclear weapons on planet Earth
options.D: More than one of the above
options.E: None of the above

questions.explanation: Earth Day is celebrated worldwide on 22 April to promote environmental awareness. It was started by American Senator Gaylord Nelson in 1970 as an environmental education initiative. The theme of Earth Day observed on 22 April 2025 was ‘Our Power, Our Planet’
